basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, just getting into gaming and exploring different online communities. Currently studying computer science, but I spend my downtime playing MMORPGs like Black Desert Online. I also enjoy hip-hop music, and I'm a big fan of Lil Yachty. My online hours are mostly in the evenings, after classes and on weekends. Single and ready to mingle, but mostly focused on leveling up in games!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to gaming communities and MMORPGs. Most of what I know comes from trial and error in games and watching YouTube tutorials. My interest in technology is growing as I pursue my computer science degree.
